column2: Avoiding AI Deception: Lie Detectors can either Induce Honesty or Evasion
column6: Fetched: FAR.AI evaluation of activation-based lie detectors on Llama 3 models (DolusChat). Qualifying findings: logistic probes flag 95-99% of deceptive responses; detector-in-the-loop training with high sensitivity (>80% TPR) cuts lying below 25% while low sensitivity (60-70%) leaves GRPO models lying >85%; DPO < GRPO deception; KL regularization drops deception 95%->25%. Empirical + methodology findings by named in-scope evaluator; within window. No matching report_id in canonical aisi_v9.csv; no known_reports.json on disk.

column2: Among us: A sandbox for measuring and detecting agentic deception
column6: Fetched: FAR.AI (Golechha, Garriga-Alonso) evaluated 18 proprietary and open-weight LLMs in a deception sandbox. Qualifying findings: RL-trained models are much better at producing deception than detecting it; logistic-regression probes on fabricated-dishonesty prompts reach AUROC >95% even on the deceptive statement alone (no CoT); SAE features aid detection. Empirical model + methodology findings by named in-scope evaluator; within window. No matching report_id in canonical; no known_reports.json on disk.

column2: GPT-4o Guardrails Gone: Data Poisoning & Jailbreak-Tuning
column6: Fetched: FAR.AI safeguard evaluation of OpenAI GPT-4o. Qualifying findings: jailbreak-tuning bypasses all GPT-4o defenses, dropping refusal rate to ~3.6% (40+ pts below standard fine-tuning on identical data); across 23 models (1.5-72B) larger models more susceptible (Gemma 2 inverse-scaling exception); harmful behaviour emerges at 0.5-2% poisoning. Empirical model findings on a named system by named in-scope evaluator; within window. No matching report_id in canonical; no known_reports.json on disk.
